problem: Ella's family flew 21 kites at the beach festival, but 6 of them got tangled high up in a palm tree. How many kites could still fly?
follow_up_questions: A lifeguard climbs the palm and frees 4 kites. How many kites can fly now?
How many kites are still caught in the palm tree?

problem: How many shuttlecocks did the badminton club still have to play with? The club owned 21 of them until 6 were hit into the gutter above the gym door.
follow_up_questions: The caretaker brings a ladder and gets 4 shuttlecocks down. How many does the club have to play with now?
How many shuttlecocks remain in the gutter?

problem: A jar in the craft room held 73 beads. Kenji's group threaded 26 beads onto a necklace and 19 beads onto a matching bracelet. How many beads are still in the jar?
follow_up_questions: The necklace is too short, so the group takes 7 more beads from the jar for it. How many beads are left in the jar?
How many beads are on the necklace and the bracelet now?

problem: Find how many nails are left in Mr. Haddad's tin. He started with 73 nails, then hammered 19 into the floor of a birdhouse and 26 into its walls.
follow_up_questions: One wall is loose, so he takes 7 more nails from the tin. How many nails does the tin hold now?
How many nails are in the birdhouse altogether?

problem: When the rain started, hotel guests borrowed 22 umbrellas from the stand in the lobby. Now 13 umbrellas are left in the stand. The lobby has a shiny marble floor. How many umbrellas were in the stand before the rain?
follow_up_questions: The hotel gift shop gives 16 umbrellas, and they go in the stand. How many umbrellas are in the stand now?
Guests borrow 11 more umbrellas. How many umbrellas are left in the stand?

problem: How many life jackets hung on the hooks at the boat dock this morning? Since then, paddlers have taken 22 of them, and 13 are still hanging. A grey heron stood on the dock all day.
follow_up_questions: The rowing club drops off 16 more life jackets on the hooks. How many are hanging now?
Then another 11 are taken. How many life jackets remain on the hooks?

problem: A library collected 67 old picture books. A teacher with 3 children came in and took some of the books for her classroom. Now 28 books are left. How many books did the teacher take?
follow_up_questions: The teacher puts all but 8 of the books she took on her classroom shelf. How many books go on the shelf?
She lends 17 of the shelf books to another class. How many shelf books stay in her room?

problem: Only 28 old bicycles are left in the scrap yard. That morning there were 67, but then a youth club drove in with 3 vans and loaded up some bikes to repair. How many bikes did the club load?
follow_up_questions: The club repairs every bike it loaded except 8. How many bikes get repaired?
It gives 17 of the repaired bikes to a summer camp. How many repaired bikes does the club keep for others?

problem: At the town's 5-hour book fair, Ms. Ortiz gave 26 bookmarks to young readers and still has 19 in her bag. How many bookmarks did she bring?
follow_up_questions: After the fair she gives away 7 more bookmarks. How many are in her bag now?
How many bookmarks did she give away that day?

problem: How many eggs did Chef Ravi bring to the breakfast stall that opens at 5 a.m.? He has cracked 26 eggs for omelettes, and 19 eggs are still in his crate.
follow_up_questions: When breakfast ends, he cracks 7 more for his own lunch. How many eggs are left in the crate?
How many eggs did he crack that day?

problem: The dance team steamed dumplings after their show. The dancers ate 27 dumplings, and 9 were left on the plates. How many dumplings had been steamed?
follow_up_questions: Their teacher wraps up 4 dumplings to take home. How many dumplings are left on the plates?
How many more dumplings did the dancers eat than the teacher took home?

problem: What was the number of sandwiches packed for the family picnic, if 9 were still in the basket at the end and everyone together had eaten 27?
follow_up_questions: Grandpa takes 4 of the leftover sandwiches for the drive home. How many stay in the basket?
By how much is the number of sandwiches eaten bigger than the number Grandpa took?

problem: Fifteen swimmers lined up for the high diving board, but 6 of them got scared and climbed back down. How many swimmers were still waiting to dive?
How many children were left in the queue for the pony ride? There were 15 in the queue until rain began, and then 6 ran off to the tent.
A class raised 30 caterpillars in a net tent, checking on them every 12 hours. Sadly, 8 caterpillars did not survive. How many caterpillars are still alive?
follow_up_questions: The teacher brings in 5 more caterpillars, and they all do well. How many are alive now?
Children take 10 caterpillars home to watch them turn into butterflies. How many stay in the classroom?
How many fewer caterpillars are in the classroom now than at the start?

problem: Of the 30 goldfish a pet shop put in its new tank, 8 got sick and had to be moved out. The tank light stays on for 12 hours a day. How many goldfish are left in the tank?
follow_up_questions: The shop adds 5 new goldfish to the tank. How many goldfish are in it now?
Customers buy 10 goldfish from the tank. How many goldfish stay in the shop's tank?
How many fewer goldfish are in the tank now than there were at first?

problem: Lukas lined up 48 dominoes on the kitchen floor. His push toppled more dominoes than his brother's had! When they stopped falling, 19 were still upright. How many dominoes toppled?
follow_up_questions: His brother flicks over 12 of the upright ones. How many are still upright?
How many dominoes are lying flat now?

problem: How many tin cans did Nia's beanbag knock down at the fair stall? The owner had piled up 48 cans, and after her throw, which hit more cans than any throw before it, 19 cans were still in place.
follow_up_questions: Her cousin's throw knocks down 12 of the cans still in place. How many cans are in place now?
How many cans are down now?

problem: For the lantern festival, the Chen family hung 12 paper lanterns in the garden, and by midnight 5 had gone out. How many lanterns were still glowing?
How many sparklers are still fizzing? At the New Year party Ahmed lit 12 of them, and 5 have already fizzled out.
A gardener bought 90 tulip bulbs for the park. At sunset, 26 bulbs were still in the sack. In all, how many bulbs had been planted?
follow_up_questions: The next day she plants 18 of the leftover bulbs in a neighbour's garden. How many bulbs are still in the sack?

problem: Altogether, how many stickers did Pedro put in his scrapbook? He had 90 stickers when he started, and 26 are still on the sheet.
follow_up_questions: The next day Pedro uses 18 of the leftover stickers on a card for his grandma. How many stickers are still on the sheet?

problem: By the middle of the month, the school cooks had used 38 of the 72 bags of rice in the kitchen. How many bags do they have for the other half of the month?
How many packs of paper does the office have for the rest of the term? It had 72 packs on the first day, and busy teachers used up 38 packs in the first few weeks.
The animal shelter's storeroom had 46 cans of dog food on Monday. Volunteers fed 25 cans to the dogs that week. How many cans are in the storeroom now?
follow_up_questions: A pet shop donates 30 cans. How many cans does the storeroom hold now?

problem: How many loaves are on the bakery shelf now? It held 46 loaves at dawn, and customers have bought 25.
follow_up_questions: The baker brings out 30 fresh loaves. How many loaves are on the shelf now?

problem: The soccer team baked cookies to sell at the town market to pay for new nets. Shoppers bought 58 cookies, and 26 were left on the tray at closing time. How many cookies did the team bake?
follow_up_questions: The team bakes 15 more cookies for the next market. How many cookies are on the tray then?
At that market, 33 cookies are sold. How many cookies are left?
How many cookies has the team sold at the two markets?

problem: At the end of the spring plant sale, 26 seedlings were still on the garden club's table. Shoppers had bought 58. How many seedlings had the club brought to sell?
follow_up_questions: For the summer sale, members add 15 more seedlings to the ones left over. How many seedlings are on the table?
During the summer sale 33 seedlings are bought. How many are left on the table?
How many seedlings did the club sell at the two sales altogether?

problem: A pipe burst in the school storeroom. The caretaker had stored 96 cardboard boxes there, but 27 got wet and had to be recycled. The storeroom light flickered the whole time. How many dry boxes does the caretaker have left?
How many bags of flour are still dry? After a storm the bakery cellar flooded, and of the 96 bags inside, 27 were ruined and thrown away. The baker's cat watched from the stairs.
The art room had 90 sheets of card. During craft week, students used 54 sheets to make birthday cards. Find the number of sheets of card left.
follow_up_questions: The next week, 27 more sheets are used. How many sheets remain?

problem: How many paper bags are left at the market stall? Before the weekend it had 90, and shoppers filled 54 of them with apples.
follow_up_questions: On Monday, 27 more bags are used. What is the number of paper bags left now?

problem: Some cyclists set out on a long ride along the coast. Seven of them got flat tires and went home early, while 15 made it all the way to the finish. How many cyclists set out?
follow_up_questions: At the finish, the cyclists who made it meet 6 runners and walk with them to the cafe. How many people walk to the cafe together?
How many more cyclists made it to the finish than went home early?

problem: How many swimmers began the lake race, if 15 reached the far shore and 7 grew too cold and climbed into the rescue boat?
follow_up_questions: On the far shore, the swimmers who made it are joined by 6 coaches for the walk back. How many people walk back together?
By how many does the number of swimmers who reached the shore beat the number who climbed into the boat?

problem: The school library has 27 board games for children to borrow, and it has 4 reading tables. Over the term some games were never returned, and now only 18 games are on the shelf. How many games are missing?
follow_up_questions: A family brings back 3 of the games. How many games are on the shelf now?
How many games are still missing?

problem: Only 18 kickboards are in the pool's storage bin now, though there used to be 27. The pool has 4 lanes. How many kickboards have gone missing?
follow_up_questions: A swimmer finds 3 of them behind the lockers and puts them back. How many kickboards are in the bin now?
How many kickboards have not been found yet?

problem: At noon, 9 of the 24 apple pickers left the orchard to help in the strawberry field. How many pickers kept working in the orchard?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, 6 of the strawberry helpers come back to the orchard. How many pickers are in the orchard now?

problem: How many nurses were left on the ward after 9 of the 24 nurses on the morning shift were sent to the busy emergency room?
follow_up_questions: Later, 6 of those nurses come back to the ward. How many nurses are on the ward now?

problem: Only 13 of the 50 ice lollies were still in the freezer box after the pool's end-of-lessons party. The lollies were shaped like little fish. How many lollies did the swimmers eat?
follow_up_questions: Coach Svetlana takes 10 lollies for the lifeguards. How many lollies are left in the box?
How many lollies were eaten or taken for the lifeguards altogether?

problem: How many muffins did the guests eat at the library's farewell party? There were 50 muffins at the start, and only 13 remained at the end. Each muffin had a little paper flag on top.
follow_up_questions: The librarian, Mr. Ito, carries 10 muffins to the office staff. How many muffins remain?
Together, how many muffins were eaten or carried to the office?

problem: Mrs. Takahashi's toy store had 23 kites hanging up this morning. She sold 8 of them before closing. How many kites are still for sale?
follow_up_questions: The next day a delivery brings 6 new kites. How many kites are for sale now?

problem: Before lunch, 8 of the 23 watermelons at Mr. Mensah's fruit stand were sold. What number of watermelons does he have left to sell?
follow_up_questions: A farmer drops off 6 more watermelons. How many watermelons are for sale now?

problem: Omar runs a pretzel cart that can hold 50 pretzels. He had 36 pretzels when he opened, and at noon 21 were still on the cart. How many pretzels did he sell this morning?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon he sells 9 more. How many pretzels are on the cart now?
How many pretzels did he sell in the whole day?

problem: At noon, 21 balloons were left at Sofia's stand. She had 36 when the fair opened, and her stand has room for 50. How many balloons did she sell before noon?
follow_up_questions: She sells 9 more balloons in the afternoon. How many are left at her stand?
What is the total number of balloons she sold that day?

problem: The Garcia twins took 7 books off the library cart, and 16 books were still on it. How many books were on the cart before?
Grandma's cookie jar has 16 cookies left after the children sneaked out 7. Find how many cookies were in the jar to start with.
Ms. Petrova took 64 candles to the craft fair. On Friday she sold 27, and on Saturday she sold 18. Her table smelled of lavender. How many candles does she still have to sell?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday she sells every candle she has except 4. How many candles does she sell on Sunday?

problem: On Saturday Leo's garage sale sold 18 comics, and the day before it had sold 27. He began with 64 comics. How many has he got left? His garage door is painted bright red.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday he sells all but 4 of those comics. How many does he sell on Sunday?

problem: The art teacher handed out 30 paintbrushes and got only 22 back in the pot at the end of the lesson. How many brushes went missing in all?
follow_up_questions: The children find 5 of the missing brushes under the sink. How many are still missing?
How many brushes are in the pot once the found ones go back in?
Then the teacher opens a new pack of 12 brushes and puts them in the pot. How many brushes are in the pot?

problem: At the start of tennis practice there were 30 balls in the basket. Some got lost in the hedges, and at the end the basket held 22. Altogether, how many balls were lost?
follow_up_questions: Players spot 5 of the lost balls in the hedge. How many balls are still lost?
Once the found balls are back in the basket, how many balls does it hold?
The coach adds a new tube of 12 balls to the basket. How many balls are in the basket now?

problem: Pavel sawed 14 centimetres off a wooden plank to make a small shelf, and the piece left over is 25 centimetres long. How long was the plank at first?
follow_up_questions: He saws another 9 centimetres off to make a peg. How long is the plank now?
How many centimetres has he sawed off in all?

problem: Lina has 25 centimetres of tape left after tearing off 14 centimetres to wrap a gift. What was the length of the tape before she tore any off?
follow_up_questions: She tears off 9 more centimetres to fix a torn page. What length of tape is left?
What is the total length she has torn off?

problem: At the start of the snowball fight, Kiri had made 20 snowballs. When the fight was over, 12 snowballs were left in her pile. How many snowballs did she throw?
How many arrows has Tomasz shot, if his quiver held 20 arrows at the start of archery practice and holds 12 now?
In a video game, Lucas spent 15 gold coins on a magic shield and still has 34 gold coins. How many gold coins did he have before buying the shield?
follow_up_questions: Next, a goblin steals 6 of his coins. How many coins does he have now?
Then he opens a treasure chest with 20 coins inside. How many coins does he have?

problem: Ama still has 34 dollars in her piggy bank after paying 15 dollars for a new scarf. How much money was in the piggy bank before?
follow_up_questions: She takes out 6 dollars for a movie ticket. How much is in the piggy bank now?
Her uncle gives her 20 dollars, and she puts it all in. How much money does the piggy bank hold?

problem: A tiler has to put 96 tiles on a bathroom wall. He has already stuck 59 tiles in place. How many tiles still have to go on the wall? The bathroom will have a blue bathtub.
follow_up_questions: His helper sticks up 18 more tiles. How many tiles are still waiting to go up?

problem: How many beads are still in the pot? Nora's bracelet kit came with 96 beads, and she has threaded 59 of them so far. The finished bracelet will be a gift for her aunt.
follow_up_questions: Her friend threads 18 more beads. How many beads are left in the pot?

problem: Mateo came into the arcade with 40 tokens and walked out with 13. How many tokens did he use in all?
follow_up_questions: His friend Luca used 8 fewer tokens than Mateo. How many tokens did Luca use?
How many tokens did the two boys use together?
Luca had 5 tokens left, and Mateo hands him all of his leftover tokens. How many tokens does Luca have now?

problem: Hana began the marble tournament with 40 marbles and finished it with 13. What is the total number of marbles she lost altogether?
follow_up_questions: Her friend Aiko lost 8 fewer marbles than Hana. How many marbles did Aiko lose?
How many marbles did the two girls lose between them?
Aiko ended with 5 marbles, and Hana gives her all the marbles Hana has left. How many marbles does Aiko have now?

problem: Jamal delivered flyers on 3 blocks of his street. He put 18 flyers into mailboxes and has 11 left in his bag. How many flyers did he start with?
follow_up_questions: The wind blows 4 of his flyers away. How many does he have now?

problem: After selling 18 flags during the 3 hours of the festival, a street vendor still has 11 flags. How many flags did she have when the festival began?
follow_up_questions: Rain soaks 4 of the flags she has left, and she throws them away. How many flags does she have now?

problem: Hugo's bakery had 45 croissants on the counter. A cafe owner bought 20 of them. How many croissants are still on the counter?
follow_up_questions: Hugo moves 10 of those croissants onto a tray in the window. How many are left on the counter?
Later he sells 7 croissants from the window tray. How many are on the tray now?

problem: A school buys 20 teddy bears for its raffle from Ms. Adeyemi's toy shop. She had 45 bears on the shelf. What number of bears are left on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: She puts 10 of the remaining bears in a basket by the door. How many bears stay on the shelf?
Then 7 bears from the basket are sold. How many bears are in the basket now?

problem: On Friday a bakery baked 92 bagels for the weekend. Customers bought 35 bagels on Saturday, and on Sunday evening only 28 were left. How many bagels were bought on Sunday?
How many trout were caught on Sunday at the fishing pond? On Friday the pond was stocked with 92 trout. Anglers caught 35 on Saturday, and by Sunday evening 28 trout were left in the pond.
At the toy claw machine, kids have grabbed 12 stuffed animals so far, and 19 are still inside. The machine glows with pink lights. How many stuffed animals were in the machine at the start?
follow_up_questions: Then kids grab 6 more. How many stuffed animals are inside now?

problem: Find how many goldfish were in the tank at the ring-toss booth when it opened. Since then players have won 12 of them, and 19 are still swimming. The booth has a red and white roof.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 more goldfish are won. How many are still swimming?

problem: Ms. Kowalski put 48 oranges in a crate for the hikers, and the hikers have taken 26 so far. How many oranges are left in the crate?
follow_up_questions: The park rangers take 9 more oranges. How many are left?
How many oranges have been taken from the crate altogether?

problem: There were 48 towels in the pile by the pool this morning. What is the number left, now that swimmers have used 26?
follow_up_questions: The diving team grabs another 9 towels. How many towels are left in the pile?
In total, how many towels have been taken from the pile?

problem: The art club had a tub of 72 googly eyes. The club has 14 members. After making paper monsters this term, 37 eyes are left in the tub. How many googly eyes went on the monsters?
follow_up_questions: They use 15 more googly eyes on masks. How many are left in the tub?
How many googly eyes did they use on monsters and masks together?
A parent donates a bag of 40 googly eyes. How many are in the tub now?

problem: There are 37 nails left in the woodwork tin, though it held 72 at the start of term. The class of 14 students used the rest on birdhouses. How many nails went into birdhouses?
follow_up_questions: Then the class uses 15 nails on a bench. How many nails are in the tin now?
How many nails were used on the birdhouses and the bench together?
The teacher pours in a box of 40 nails. How many nails does the tin hold now?

problem: Isla's bookshelf holds 19 books today. That is 7 fewer than yesterday, because she gave some to her cousin. How many books were on the shelf yesterday?
What number of towers did Mateo's sandcastle have at noon? The waves have washed some away, leaving 19 towers, which is 7 fewer than at noon.
Amelia has picked 34 apples from the orchard. How many apples will she have after she bakes 15 of them into pies?
follow_up_questions: The next day she picks 12 more apples. How many apples does she have now?

problem: If Darius gives 15 of his 34 baseball cards to his little brother, what will be the size of his card collection?
follow_up_questions: For his birthday he gets a pack of 12 new cards. How many cards does he have now?

problem: Lucia had 80 seashells at the end of the beach trip. She gave 26 shells to Oskar and some to Farah, and now she has 31. How many shells did Farah get?
follow_up_questions: Farah gives back 9 of the shells she got. How many shells does Lucia have now?
How many of the shells she was given does Farah still keep?

problem: How many stamps went to Ibrahim? Before the stamp club met, Chloe owned 80 stamps. She now has 31, after swapping 26 to Ming and the rest of the missing ones to Ibrahim.
follow_up_questions: Ibrahim returns 9 of his new stamps to Chloe. How many stamps does Chloe own now?
How many of the swapped stamps does Ibrahim still have?

problem: A puppy chewed up 6 of Oliver's socks, and 42 socks are still in his drawer. How many socks were in the drawer before the puppy got in?
How many crayons were in the box before the baby threw 6 of them behind the radiator? Now there are 42 crayons in the box.
A class of 28 children started the nature walk, but some sat down to rest on a bench. Only 21 children were still walking when they reached the pond. How many children stopped to rest?
follow_up_questions: At the pond, 5 of the resting children catch up. How many children are walking now?

problem: At the river crossing, 21 runners were still running in the charity race, which had started with 28. How many runners had stopped to rest?
follow_up_questions: At the crossing, 5 of the resting runners join in again. How many are running now?

problem: A garden centre sold 17 seed packets on Monday and 26 on Tuesday, and then it had 38 packets left on the rack. How many seed packets did it have on Monday morning? The shop always smells of fresh soil.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday 40 more packets arrive. How many packets does it have then?
A school garden club buys 25 of them. How many packets are left?
How many packets has the garden centre sold since Monday?

problem: There were 38 yo-yos left in the toy shop on Tuesday night, after it sold 26 that day and 17 on Monday. A rocking horse stands by the shop door. What number of yo-yos did the shop have when it opened on Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday a box of 40 yo-yos is delivered. How many yo-yos does the shop have now?
A birthday party orders 25 yo-yos. How many are left?
Since Monday, how many yo-yos has the shop sold?

problem: This morning there were 45 ripe strawberries on the plants. The children have picked 18 of them. What is the total number still on the plants?
follow_up_questions: After lunch they pick 9 more. How many are still on the plants?

problem: The hens laid 45 eggs overnight. Altogether, how many eggs are still in the nests if Farmer Aziz's son has already collected 18?
follow_up_questions: Later he collects 9 more. How many eggs are still in the nests?

problem: At the reading club party, held in a room with 60 chairs, the teacher gave 46 pencils to the poetry winners and 29 to the story winners. She has 15 pencils left in her box. How many pencils did she bring?
How many ribbons did the judge bring to the dog show? She pinned 46 ribbons on puppies and 29 on older dogs, and 15 ribbons are still in her pocket. The show ring is 60 metres wide.
Grandpa has a ball of string 30 metres long. He uses 12 metres to tie up his tomato plants. How much string is left?
follow_up_questions: He then uses 5 metres to hang a bird feeder. How much string does he have now?

problem: What length of wire is left on the roll? An electrician started with 30 metres and has used 12 metres in a new kitchen.
follow_up_questions: She then uses 5 metres in the hallway. How many metres of wire are on the roll now?

problem: A gust of wind blew some cards off Anika's card tower. The tower had 33 cards before and has 25 now. How many cards blew off?
follow_up_questions: Anika puts 4 of the fallen cards back on. How many cards does the tower have now?
How many fallen cards are still on the floor?

problem: How many apples fell off the cart when it hit a bump? Mr. Bello's cart had 33 apples before the bump and has 25 after it.
follow_up_questions: He picks up 4 of the fallen apples and puts them back. How many apples are on the cart now?
How many of the fallen apples are still on the road?

problem: At the toy shop, Lin paid 45 dollars for a scooter and 28 dollars for a helmet, and she still has 19 dollars. How much money did she bring? A toy train runs in the shop window.
follow_up_questions: Her grandma gives her 30 dollars. How much money does she have now?
She buys a bell for 16 dollars. How much money is left?
How much has she spent at the toy shop altogether?

problem: Before visiting the wizard's market, how many gems did Bram's elf have? It still has 19 gems after buying a potion for 45 gems and a cloak for 28 gems. The elf wears a tall green hat.
follow_up_questions: The elf finds 30 gems in a cave. How many gems does it have now?
It trades 16 gems for a lantern at the market. How many gems are left?
How many gems has the elf spent at the market in all?

problem: Kofi started the card game with 30 chips. He had to pay 12 chips as a fine. How many chips does he have in all now?
In all, how many marbles are in Zoe's bag now? It had 30 marbles before she lost 12 in a game with her cousin.
Ayla's model kit had 60 parts. She has been building for 25 minutes, and 22 parts are still in the bag. How many parts has she already put together?
follow_up_questions: She attaches 7 more parts. How many are still in the bag?

problem: There are still 22 tiles in the box of Mosa's mosaic kit, which came with 60. He has spent 25 minutes on it today. Find how many tiles he has already glued down.
follow_up_questions: He glues down 7 more tiles. How many are left in the box?

problem: The bakery window still shows 31 cakes after 24 were sold today. How many cakes were on display when the bakery opened?
follow_up_questions: The baker puts 10 new cakes in the window. How many cakes are on display now?
By closing time another 18 cakes are sold. How many cakes are still on display?

problem: How many books stood on the school's free-book shelf this morning? Children have taken 24, and 31 books are still standing there.
follow_up_questions: The librarian adds 10 new books. How many books are on the shelf now?
By the end of the day, children take 18 more. How many books are left on the shelf?

problem: A farmer has 75 sheep to shear before summer. So far he has sheared 39 of them. How many sheep still have their thick wool?
follow_up_questions: Then he shears 17 more. How many sheep still have their wool?

problem: The cleaners washed 39 of the school's 75 windows on Monday. What number of windows still need washing?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday they wash 17 more. How many windows still need washing?

problem: On Monday a flower stall had 40 bunches of daisies, and by Saturday 26 bunches were left. The stall has a green awning. How many bunches were sold during the week?
follow_up_questions: This week a van brings 15 more bunches. How many bunches does the stall have now?
If 9 of them are sold by Wednesday, how many are left?

problem: Last week the gym's fridge went from 40 water bottles on Monday to 26 by Saturday. The fridge door squeaks loudly. Work out how many bottles were sold.
follow_up_questions: This week the gym puts in a crate of 15 bottles. How many bottles are in the fridge now?
By Wednesday 9 of them have been sold. How many bottles are left?

problem: Hiroshi used 13 nails to build a birdhouse, and 17 nails are left in his toolbox. How many nails were in the toolbox before?
There are 17 grapes left in the bowl because Fatima ate thirteen of them. How many grapes were in the bowl to begin with?
The school bake sale had 90 cookie tokens to sell, and families have bought 47 of them. There are 5 tables at the sale. How many tokens are still unsold?
follow_up_questions: Then a grandfather buys 12 tokens. How many tokens are still unsold?

problem: How many seats are still empty in the theatre? It has 90 seats, the play has 5 acts, and 47 seats have been filled so far.
follow_up_questions: Then a group of 12 arrives and sits in empty seats. How many seats are still empty?

problem: Ms. Ferreira lined up 26 chairs for the school play. Some toddlers tipped a few over, and 19 are still upright. How many more chairs does she need to set back up?
follow_up_questions: She sets 4 of them upright. How many chairs are upright now?
How many chairs are still lying on the floor?
A toddler tips over 5 of the upright chairs. How many chairs are upright?

problem: A storm blew over some of the 26 flower pots on Mr. Diaz's balcony, leaving 19 still standing. How many more pots must he lift back up?
follow_up_questions: He lifts 4 of them back up. How many pots are standing now?
How many pots are still on their sides?
The wind knocks over 5 standing pots. How many pots are standing?

problem: Aunt Rosa clipped 18 clothes pegs onto the washing line, and 27 pegs are still in her peg bag. How many pegs were in the bag before she started?
follow_up_questions: When the washing is dry she takes 10 pegs off the line and puts them back in the bag. How many pegs are in the bag now?
How many pegs are still on the line?

problem: There are 27 thumbtacks left in the box after Mr. Lund used 18 to pin up artwork. What was the number of thumbtacks in the box at first?
